text: Remote work really has turned things on their head. If we're looking at the positive side, it's a new level of flexibility for workers so we can manage both work and life. On the other side, businesses are able to get talent from all kinds of places, and reduce overheads. Yet it's not completely smooth. Communication can go down the drain, the team cohesion can slip over time. Or people struggle with feeling completely isolated, not able to get between work and life. Really though, to make this work, we need policies that have been thought through carefully, clear expectations, and we need to find ways for people to connect, even digitally.
